alphabet.name: Latin Alphabet (Spanish)
alphabet.letters: A B C D E F G H I J K L M N Ñ O P Q R S T U V W X Y Z
alphabet.accents: á é í ó ú ü ñ ¿ ¡
alphabet.note: Spanish has 27 letters including Ñ. Spanish is highly phonetic — words are pronounced as they are written.
alphabet.pronunciation_guide: Each vowel has exactly one sound. Stress falls on the penultimate syllable by default.
